setting.note: In the coal country of northern France in the 1860s, a drifter takes work at a pit and is drawn into a doomed miners' strike, told across the pit head, the terraced coron and the slag heap of a whole company town.

rights.originalWork: Public domain. Émile Zola, first published 1885; the author died in 1902. Mapped here as a cited work: we store none of its text and reproduce no passages. The places are facts and the notes are our own.

palette.note: The banked fire of the pit and of the strike that flares up in it, the red seed of the title. A dark ember tone that clears WCAG AA on paper.
